acting.hint: One browser, the whole team — switch seats to play each role on the same patient.
acting.youAreAi: This role is AI-held. Switch into it to act it yourself.
acting.label: Acting role

scope.doctor: Lead the workup: take the history, order tests and treatments, commit the diagnosis and plan.
scope.nurse: Run the bedside: work the task queue, administer medications, monitor the live response, escalate.
scope.paramedic: Set the scene: give the prehospital picture and a structured ATMIST/SBAR handover.

orders.title: Orders & handoff
orders.subtitle: The doctor orders; the order becomes a task in the executing role's queue.
orders.doctorOnly: Only the doctor can place orders. Switch to the doctor seat to order for the team.

task.queueSubtitle: Orders handed to the team, with status and a realistic turnaround.
task.empty: No tasks yet. Orders the doctor places will land here as work for the team.
task.mineEmpty: Your queue is clear. New orders assigned to you will appear here.
task.notYours: Switch to the {{role}} seat to execute this task.

vitals.sharedNote: One shared patient — every role reads the same live monitor.

handoff.title: Handoff
handoff.empty: No handoffs yet. Pass control to record one here.

paramedic.title: Prehospital handover
paramedic.desc: You brought the patient in. Give the team the scene picture and the timeline, then hand over to the doctor.

nurse.title: Bedside & task queue
nurse.desc: Work the doctor's orders, administer medications, and watch the shared monitor respond.

doctor.title: Workup & orders
doctor.desc: Take the history, order tests and treatments for the team, and commit the plan.

debrief.note: The team loop above is earned from what actually happened this session: doctor orders, nurse executions, and the patient's live response.
